original_question: In Lobachevsky space of sufficiently large dimension, does there exist a discrete cocompact isometric action generated entirely by central symmetries?
target_in_paper: Section 10, 'Group generated by central symmetries,' part (b) in the 'Overheard' section. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))
correct_elements: Your draft already captures the paper’s exact target: the ambient Lobachevsky space, the large-dimension regime, the requirement of a discrete cocompact isometric action, and the restriction that the acting group be generated by central symmetries. It is therefore aimed at part (b), not at the neighboring parts (a) or (c). ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))
missing_details: Make the ambient space explicit as the real hyperbolic (Lobachevsky) space H^n, since the paper gives the problem in words rather than with added notation. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))

Unpack 'of sufficiently large dimension' into an explicit quantifier, e.g. 'there exists N such that for every n >= N ...'; otherwise it is ambiguous whether the question asks for one large dimension or all sufficiently large dimensions. This is the natural stand-alone expansion of the paper’s phrase. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))

State the acting object explicitly as a discrete subgroup Γ <= Isom(H^n) acting cocompactly, equivalently with compact quotient H^n/Γ. This makes the paper’s 'discrete cocompact isometric action' fully stand-alone. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))

Clarify 'central symmetry' as a point-reflection involution, i.e. an order-2 isometry fixing a point, because the section does not separately define the phrase. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))

Replace the potentially ambiguous phrase 'generated entirely by central symmetries' with 'generated by central symmetries': the intended condition is that Γ has a generating set consisting of central symmetries, not that every element of Γ is itself a central symmetry. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))

Do not add freeness or torsion-free assumptions: the paper does not require the action to be free, and the nearby context explicitly groups this question with versions allowing finite-order generators. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))
refined_question: Does there exist an integer N such that, for every n >= N, the n-dimensional Lobachevsky (real hyperbolic) space H^n admits a cocompact action by a discrete subgroup Γ <= Isom(H^n) such that Γ is generated by central symmetries, i.e. point-reflection involutions?
justification: The paper’s official formulation is the three-part open problem in Section 10, and your draft is specifically part (b): whether Lobachevsky space in sufficiently large dimension admits a discrete cocompact isometric action generated by central symmetries. The sentence immediately following the three parts adds the only nearby context: Vinberg ruled out the reflection-generated analogue and 'the remaining questions are completely open,' which confirms that part (b) is the precise paper target and that it should not be broadened to the more general finite-order or codimension-k rotation variants. My refinement only makes the implicit quantifiers and group-action language explicit so the question stands alone. ([ar5iv.org](https://ar5iv.org/pdf/2510.11908))
